Before starting

1. Connect Barka Tunnel to the VPN and wait for “Connected”.
2. Enable the phone’s mobile hotspot.
3. Return to this screen, then tap “Start”.
Hotspot address unavailable. Check that the mobile hotspot is enabled, then try again.
IP Finder • Vibration not requested: Barka Tunnel notifications are disabled in Android.
IP Finder • Direct vibration not requested: Do Not Disturb filtering is active or unknown.
IP Finder • Vibration not requested: check vibration and alert mode for the “Compatible IP found” channel in Android settings.
IP Finder • Android detected no available vibrator.
IP Finder • Vibration requested from Android (two pulses). This does not confirm physical vibration.
